mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from iam_user u join rbac_role_binding b on b.subject_type = 'USER' and b.subject_id = u.id and b.role_code = #{roleCode} and b.scope_type = 'PLATFORM' and b.scope_id is null and b.status = 'ENABLED' and b.deleted_at is null where u.status = 'ENABLED' and u.deleted_at is null )
select id from rbac_role where code = #{roleCode} and status = 'ENABLED' and deleted_at is null

insert into iam_user ( username, password_hash, display_name, email, status, must_change_password ) values ( #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{email}, 'ENABLED', #{mustChangePassword} ) returning id
mapper.insert: insert into rbac_role_binding ( subject_type, subject_id, role_id, role_code, scope_type, scope_id, status, created_by, updated_by ) values ( 'USER', #{userId}, #{roleId}, #{roleCode}, 'PLATFORM', null, 'ENABLED', #{userId}, #{userId} )

insert into audit_log ( trace_id, actor_type, actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, scope_type, scope_id, result, after_json ) values ( #{traceId}, 'SYSTEM', #{actorUserId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, 'PLATFORM', null, 'SUCCESS', cast('{"bootstrap":true}' as jsonb) )
